Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::genereateApprovalLetter(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanRequest: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(lr|lr.RequestID = id),
		approvalLetter: ApprovalLetter
	precondition:
		loanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		approvalLetter.oclIsNew() and
		ApprovalLetter.allInstance()->includes(approvalLetter) and
		approvalLetter.Content = "ApprovalLetterContent" and
		loanRequest.AttachedApprovalLetter = approvalLetter and
		CurrentLoanRequest = loanRequest and
		result = true
}
